question: What general meanings does the MUTCD assign to fluorescent pink, orange, and purple?
model_answer: Direct Answer: The MUTCD's color code assigns fluorescent pink to incident management, orange to temporary traffic control, and purple to use restricted to vehicles with registered electronic toll collection (ETC) accounts. Because these colors carry critical, higher-priority meanings, they are prohibited as background colors on community wayfinding guide signs and on shared-use path destination guide signs. Standards (mandatory): - "The general meaning of the 13 colors shall be as follows: ... E. Fluorescent Pink-incident management ... I. Orange-temporary traffic control J. Purple-restricted to use only by vehicles with registered electronic toll collection (ETC) accounts ..." - "The standard colors of red, orange, yellow, purple, or the fluorescent versions thereof, fluorescent yellow-green, and fluorescent pink shall not be used as background colors for community wayfinding guide signs, in order to minimize possible confusion with critical, higher-priority regulatory and warning sign color meanings readily understood by road users." - "The standard colors of red, orange, yellow, purple, or the fluorescent versions thereof, fluorescent yellow-green, and fluorescent pink shall not be used as background colors for Destination Guide signs for shared-use paths, in order to minimize possible confusion with critical, higher-priority regulatory and warning sign color meanings readily understood by path users." Citations: - Section 1D.05 Standard §2 (p.33) - Section 2D.55 Standard §19 (p.271) - Section 9D.12 Standard §27 (p.1084) - Section 6F.01 Support §3 (p.789) Note: As Support (informational only), Section 6F.01 explains that the fluorescent version of orange provides higher conspicuity than standard orange, especially during twilight.
gold_answer: Fluorescent pink is for incident management, orange is for temporary traffic control, and purple is restricted to vehicles with registered electronic toll collection accounts.
